author: IGN
description:
It’s been a year of ups and downs for Monster Hunter Wilds. The game broke numerous launch and concurrent player records within days of release on Steam, and yet many felt the game was too easy, and was missing core features that were present in previous Monster Hunter titles. Just like with most Monster Hunter games released in the last decade though, the team at Capcom has been hard at work providing regular free title updates for the game throughout 2025 to add new monsters, improve the end-game grind, and provide some real challenges for the experienced hunters out there. Here is everything that’s been added to Monster Hunter Wilds since launch.

Timestamps:
00:00 - Intro
00:41 - Balance Update and Bug Fix Disclaimer
01:09 - Title Update 1: Mizutsune & The Grand Hub
02:31 - Free Title Update 1 Roadmap
04:01 - Title Update 2: Lagiacrus & Sergios
05:03 - Free Title Update 2 Roadmap
05:48 - 9-Star Quest Update
06:25 - Title Update 3: Omega Planetes (FF XIV)
08:09 - Free Title Update
title: Monster Hunter Wilds: Everything Major Added Since Launch

author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Microsoft finally showed off Forza Horizon 6 gameplay in yesterday's Developer_Direct, and of course the game looks gorgeous. You'll be able to play the game ahead of its official May 15 release date if you jump on the premium upgrade, but it'll cost you the price of a new game. For about $60, you get access to upcoming expansions, car packs, more cosmetics, and early access. If you're a Game Pass subscriber, you're getting the game for free, so that makes the upgrade price a little easier to swallow. In other news, the Fable reboot devs have revealed some of the inspiration for the game: modern British sitcoms. And speaking of sitcoms, Michael Scott and Dwight Schrute from the American version of The Office are coming to Fortnite.
title: Forza Horizon 6's Premium Upgrade is the Price of a New Game - IGN Daily Fix

author: IGN
description:
Take a look at the Dead By Daylight: The Hillbilly Comic Issue #1 trailer for this upcoming comic book series based on the horror video game franchise. Issue #1 of Dead By Daylight: The Hillbilly arrives in comic shops on April 8, 2026.

Written by Derek Fridolfs (Batman: Arkham City), with art by Dean Kotz (Black Hammer, The Savage Sword of Conan) and colors by Allison Hu (Corvus) Titan’s new comic series will explore the origins of one of Dead by Daylight's original killers, The Hillbilly, and follows a rookie cop uncovering the face of pure evil.
title: Dead By Daylight: The Hillbilly Comic Issue #1 - Official Trailer

author: IGN
description: Check out the Gameplay Trailer for Resonant Q, a third-person survival horror action shooter developed by Japan Productions. Players will shoot their way through the challenges that lie on a collapsing Orbital Ring above a decimated Earth. Make use of an array of weapons, balance resources, and engage all manner of anomalies alone or with friends in three-player co-op. Resonant Q is launching in 2026 for PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Resonant Q - Official Gameplay Trailer
